gpt_pro_web_attempt.details: tool_search exposed node_repl and unrelated connectors/docs tools, but no Browser/iab control tool for ChatGPT.com Pro in this session.

diagnosis: Run6 fixed a real checkpoint-selection mismatch: monitor verification peaked at epoch 14 and degraded by the final epoch.
The remaining gap is concentrated in per-class score tails and weak positive scores for low-recall words, not global top-k recognition alone.
Partial teacher coverage may be uneven by class, but this is not yet proven by the existing receipts.
research_conclusion.selected_preflight: Implement and run a no-Brev run6 verification-tail failure audit joined with class counts, teacher coverage, positive/negative score quantiles, high-scoring negative labels, hard-negative pairs, and class contribution to the 0.85-gate gap.
research_conclusion.recommendation: Audit run6 score-tail failures and class/teacher-coverage imbalance before any paid run7; only launch capped class-balanced CE if that audit confirms imbalance or coverage-driven weak classes.
pass_criteria: Recompute run6 test verification recall@FAR10 within abs <= 0.002 of 0.8039.
Emit complete rows for all classes with positives and negatives.

Show low-recall classes have materially lower train counts or teacher-covered counts than the class median, or below-median count/coverage classes average at least 0.05 lower recall@FAR10 than above-median classes.
Show identified weak classes account for at least 0.020 of the mean-recall shortfall versus the 0.85 gate.
Show no data-labeling or split-join bug before any paid run7.

future_paid_run_if_audit_passes.recipe: run6 unchanged except capped class-balanced CE and the same monitor_verification_recall_far10 checkpoint selection

paid_run_kill_conditions: Kill if actual optimizer steps differ from expected 13200.
Kill if class-balanced weights are missing, NaN, infinite, all equal unexpectedly, or exceed 4.0.
Kill if loss becomes NaN or infinite.
Kill if verification evaluation is not emitted or checkpoint metric is not monitor_verification_recall_far10.
By epoch 30, kill if best monitor verification recall@FAR10 is below 0.790.
By epoch 60, kill if best monitor verification recall@FAR10 is below 0.817.
By epoch 120, kill if best monitor verification recall@FAR10 is below 0.840.
By epoch 180, kill if best monitor verification recall@FAR10 is below 0.850.
research_conclusion.why_supcon_tuning_waits: Run5 already improved top-1/top-5 while slightly reducing primary verification recall, so more SupCon is not the smallest metric-aligned next move.
research_conclusion.why_t40_waits: T=40 requires additional cache/model preflight and does not directly target the observed per-class score-tail failure.
research_conclusion.why_capacity_waits: Run6 verification recall peaked early and degraded later, so more capacity could amplify overfitting or calibration issues before the per-class objective issue is understood.

next_action.reason: Run6 is the running best but remains below the gate; audit weak class score tails, class counts, teacher coverage, and hard negatives before any paid class-balanced run7.
